exports.name: HTTPServerEvents
signatures:
interface HTTPServerEvents {
  request: [req: HTTPIncomingMessage, res: HTTPServerResponse]
  checkContinue: [req: HTTPIncomingMessage, res: HTTPServerResponse]
  checkExpectation: [req: HTTPIncomingMessage, res: HTTPServerResponse]
  upgrade: [req: HTTPIncomingMessage, socket: TCPSocket, head: Buffer]
  connect: [req: HTTPIncomingMessage, socket: TCPSocket, head: Buffer]
  clientError: [err: HTTPError, socket: TCPSocket]
  timeout: [socket: TCPSocket]
  close: []
  connection: [socket: TCPSocket]
  drop: [info: TCPServerDropInfo]
  error: [err: Error]
  listening: []
  lookup: [err: Error | null, address: string | null, family: IPFamily | 0, host: string]
}
exports.description:
The events an `HTTPServer` emits in addition to the underlying TCP server's events: `request`,
for each incoming request; `checkContinue` and `checkExpectation`, for a request that announced
an expectation; `upgrade` and `connect`, when a connection is handed over; `clientError`, when a
connection fails; `timeout`, when a connection's socket times out.

members.name: checkContinue
members.description:
Emitted instead of `'request'` when a request carries `Expect: 100-continue` and a listener is
attached, letting the handler call `res.writeContinue()` or refuse the body itself. Without a
listener the continue is sent automatically and `'request'` is emitted.

members.name: checkExpectation
members.description:
Emitted instead of `'request'` when a request carries an `Expect` header other than
`100-continue` and a listener is attached. Without a listener the request is answered with
`417 Expectation Failed`.

members.name: clientError
members.description:
Emitted when a connection fails, for example on a malformed request. Without a listener the
server answers with an error response of its own before taking the connection down.

members.name: close
members.description: Emitted when the server closes.

members.name: connect
signatures: connect: [req: HTTPIncomingMessage, socket: TCPSocket, head: Buffer]
members.description:
Emitted for a `CONNECT` request, with the socket and any bytes already read past the request.
The socket is destroyed if the event has no listener.

members.name: connection
members.description: Emitted when a new connection is received. The argument is a `TCPSocket`.

members.name: drop
members.description:
Emitted when an incoming connection is dropped because `maxConnections` was exceeded, with
details of the dropped connection.

members.name: error
members.description: Emitted when an error occurs.

members.name: listening
members.description: Emitted when the server starts listening.

members.name: lookup
signatures: lookup: [err: Error | null, address: string | null, family: IPFamily | 0, host: string]
members.description: Emitted after resolving the hostname. The arguments are `err`, `address`, `family`, and `host`.

members.name: request
members.description:
Emitted for each request received, with the `HTTPIncomingMessage` for the request and the

validating both.

params.name: name
params.description:
The header name (case-insensitive); must be a valid RFC 9110 token, and must not
be `__proto__`.

params.name: value
params.description:
The header value; must not contain a control character other than tab. Every
element of an array value is checked in turn, and `null` is allowed.

throws.condition: the headers have already been sent.
`name` is not a valid RFC 9110 token, or is `__proto__`.

`value` is `undefined`, or contains a control character other
than tab.

interface HTTPClientConnection {

}

The per-socket state machine that parses response data for an `HTTPClientRequest`, and drives
its `'response'` event.

members.name: HTTPClientConnection.from
members.description:
Returns the existing `HTTPClientConnection` for `socket`, creating one with `opts` if none
exists yet.

params.name: socket
params.description: The socket to look up or create a connection for.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options used if a new connection is created.

members.name: idle
members.description: Whether the connection currently has no in-flight request.

members.name: keepAliveTimeout
members.description:
How long the peer said it holds the connection open for, in milliseconds, or `-1` when it said
nothing.

members.name: req
members.description: The `HTTPClientRequest` currently in flight on this connection, or `null` if none.

members.name: res
members.description: The `HTTPIncomingMessage` currently being read on this connection, or `null` if none.

members.name: socket
members.description: The underlying `TCPSocket` for this connection.

exports.description:
The `method` map of supported HTTP method names and the `status` map of status codes to their
reason phrases.

members.name: constants.HTTPMethod
members.description: A key of `constants.method`, that is one of the supported HTTP method names.

members.name: constants.HTTPStatusCode
members.description:
An HTTP status code. Any three digit code may be sent or received, so the codes named in
`constants.status` are only the ones that have a reason phrase of their own rather than the
whole of what is allowed.

members.name: constants.HTTPStatusMessage
members.description:
An HTTP reason phrase. Any field value may stand in for the reason phrase, so the phrases in
`constants.status` are only the ones a code is given by default rather than the whole of what
is allowed.

exports.name: HTTPError
exports.description:
An error thrown by `bare-http1` for protocol-level failures, such as an unimplemented method, a
lost connection, a suspended agent, or an invalid header. Carries a `code` identifying the
specific failure.
